title: 精卫 (DJ 0.88x 纯音乐 · 3.80s Drop 前置母带)

shots.l2A: 一句“十亿【一人公司】”，点燃了全网的造富梦；
shots.l2B: 可【14万星】开源作者，收入却不够交服务器电费。
shots.enA: A viral promise of a billion-dollar one-person company ignited the Super-Individual craze;
shots.enB: yet a 140k-star solo creator cannot even pay his own server electricity bill.
shots.visual: Phone & Window Split Contrast (OpenAI $1B viral card vs 3AM GitHub 140k-star OpenClaw server bill -¥23,800 & 99+ tickets)
shots.carryOut: Right billing window expands into Creator Studio analytics dashboard

shots.l2A: 有人用AI两周狂发【520条】视频，播放看着很热闹；
shots.l2B: 可打开收款后台一看，真实商业转化却是【零进账】。
shots.enA: One creator used AI to pump out 520 videos in two weeks with lively view counts;
shots.enB: yet the merchant ledger shows a glaring zero in real commercial revenue.
shots.visual: Creator Studio Analytics UI (520 AI videos in 14 days) vs WeChat/Stripe Merchant Ledger (¥0.00 conversion)
shots.carryOut: Merchant ledger unfolds into the ¥1,000,000 Annual P&L Statement

shots.l1A: 百万流水 · 净剩 12 万
shots.l2A: 明明不用给员工发工资，百万流水怎么只剩【12万】？
shots.l2B: 当我们拆开【超级个体】账本，才看清那座隐形暗箱。
shots.enA: With zero employee payroll, how does a million in revenue shrink to just 120k?
shots.enB: Opening the real ledger of the Super-Individual reveals an invisible black box.
shots.visual: Solo Studio Annual P&L Waterfall Card (¥100w -> -70w Traffic -> -18w Compute -> ¥12w Net) + Monumental Title Seal
shots.carryOut: P&L card flips onto warm archival paper monograph (1937 Coase)

shots.l2A: 为什么世界需要公司？诺奖得主【科斯】早就给过答案：
shots.l2B: 公司像五面盾牌，替你挡下【90%】的法务、报税与杂事。
shots.enA: Why do firms exist? Nobel laureate Ronald Coase did the math back in 1937:
shots.enB: a company acts as a five-layer shield, absorbing 90% of legal, tax, and channel friction.
shots.visual: 1937 Ronald Coase Archival Monograph Card + 5-Shield Organizational Blueprint (Legal/Tax/Sales/Ops/Brand)
shots.carryOut: 5 organizational shields power down and vanish, exposing the solo desk

shots.l2A: 一旦辞职撤掉公司外壳，AI确实省下了【写代码】时间；
shots.l2B: 可发票、合同与售后纠纷，瞬间吞噬了你【82%】的精力。
shots.enA: Once you leave the firm's shell, AI certainly saves you coding hours;
shots.enB: yet tax filings, contracts, and refund disputes instantly swallow 82% of your energy.
shots.visual: 10 Real Work Alert Modals (Tax Error, Contract Dispute, Ad Ban, DDoS, Refund Ticket) + 18% vs 82% Time Bar
shots.carryOut: Time allocation bar stretches into the X-axis of the Supply vs CAC Scissors Chart

shots.l2A: 所有人都能用AI造出产品，市场供给暴涨【100倍】；
shots.l2B: 可买单客户没变多，抢流量的成本反倒贵了【10倍】。
shots.enA: When anyone can ship an AI product overnight, market supply explodes 100-fold;
shots.enB: yet buyer attention stays flat, driving customer acquisition costs up 10-fold.
shots.visual: Dual-Curve Scissors Chart (Supply +100x gold curve vs CAC 10x vermilion curve breaking top border) + App Flood Matrix
shots.carryOut: Chart frame morphs into 2026 Journal of Managerial Psychology Card (N=6,505)

shots.l2A: 不用坐班总该更轻松吧？【2026年】一项心理学研究，
shots.l2B: 连续半年追踪了【6505名】高自由度的独立工作者。
shots.enA: Surely no commute and no boss means less stress? A landmark 2026 psychology study
shots.enB: tracked 6,505 high-autonomy solo workers across six full months.
shots.visual: 2026 Journal of Managerial Psychology Archival Card (N=6,505) + 5 Autonomy Dimension Bars + Highlighter Sweep
shots.carryOut: 5 autonomy bars wrap into a 24-hour work activity clock heatmap

shots.l2A: 以前下班能合上电脑，单干后每分休息都像在【亏钱】；
shots.l2B: 明明没有老板盯着，你却把自己逼成了【全天候】监工。
shots.enA: In an office you could close your laptop at six; solo, every minute of rest feels like losing money;
shots.enB: with no boss watching, you turn into your own ruthless 24/7 taskmaster.
shots.visual: Dual Work-Hour Clock Heatmap (9-to-6 Office Green Clock vs 00:00-24:00 Solo Red Overload Clock + 23:30/02:15/05:00 Alerts)
shots.carryOut: Clock hands unfold into the 6-month N=6,505 Burnout Divergence Chart

shots.l2A: 数据揭开了残酷的【自主权悖论】：自由度最高的人，
shots.l2B: 半年后的情绪耗竭与倦怠，反而比预期暴涨了【42%】。
shots.enA: The data exposed a brutal Autonomy Paradox: those with the highest freedom
shots.enB: suffered a 42% surge in emotional exhaustion and cognitive burnout after six months.
shots.visual: N=6,505 Empirical Divergence Curve (Expected relaxation dashed green vs Actual +42% Burnout vermilion surge) + Seal Stamp
shots.carryOut: +42% curve morphs into the ¥100 Revenue Sankey Split Stream

shots.l2A: 省下来的员工工资去哪了？全交了平台的【买量过路费】。
shots.l2B: 每赚一百块，【70%】被渠道抽走，扣完算力只剩十二块。
shots.enA: Where did the saved payroll go? Straight into platform traffic tolls:
shots.enB: out of every 100 yuan earned, 70% goes to ad channels and 18% to compute, leaving 12.
shots.visual: Precision Revenue Sankey Split Chart (¥100 Gross -> -¥70 Platform Traffic Tax -> -¥18 API/SaaS -> ¥12 Net Pocket)
shots.carryOut: ¥12 net droplet expands into @levelsio 10x7 Project Matrix

shots.l2A: 连全球头号独立开发者，十年间先后做了【70个】项目，
shots.l2B: 也有【66个】惨淡归零，真正跑通盈利的只有区区四个。
shots.enA: Even the world's most profitable solo founder, Pieter Levels, shipped 70 projects;
shots.enB: 66 of them failed outright, and only 4 ever became profitable hits (5.7%).
shots.visual: @levelsio Profile Card + 10x7 (70 Projects) Matrix Grid (66 red-crossed failures vs 4 golden hits = 5.7% hit rate)
shots.carryOut: 70-project grid compresses into r/Solopreneur Income Distribution Bar Chart

shots.l2A: 社区统计显示，【83%】的独立开发者月入不足五百刀；
shots.l2B: 真正稳赚不赔的，是收【1999元】教人单干的卖铲课。
shots.enA: Community surveys show 83% of indie makers earn under $500 a month;
shots.enB: the only guaranteed fortune is charging ¥1,999 to teach the Super-Individual dream.
shots.visual: r/Solopreneur Income Distribution Bar Chart (83% < $500/mo) vs Viral ¥1,999 Course Checkout Boom Card
shots.carryOut: Income bars rotate vertically into the 0-100 Capability Value Scale

shots.l1A: 机器秒达 60 分及格线
shots.l2A: 为什么工具越强越难赚？只因AI帮你跨过【60分】线；
shots.l2B: 可市场真正稀缺的，恰恰是机器跨不过的【95分】壁垒。
shots.enA: Why is money harder to make as tools improve? AI only gets everyone to a 60-point pass;
shots.enB: what commands a premium is the 95-point moat of deep craft and edge-case mastery.
shots.visual: Capability Value Bar & Moat Chart (5 skills instantly hit 60-pt line; brass wall blocks path to 95-pt professional moat)
shots.carryOut: 60-pt bars multiply into 500 identical bidding cards in Freelance Marketplace UI

shots.l2A: 当几百万人握着一模一样的【60分】方案冲进市场，
shots.l2B: 结局只能是惨烈压价，把五千块单子生生卷成【99块】。
shots.enA: When millions flood the market holding identical 60-point AI outputs,
shots.enB: the inevitable result is a brutal bidding war crashing ¥5,000 jobs down to ¥99.
shots.visual: Freelance Bidding War UI (500 identical AI bids) + Price Crash Step Chart (¥5,000 -> ¥800 -> ¥99) + Zero-Pricing-Power Seal
shots.carryOut: Bidding card flips onto warm historical comparison ledger (1780 vs 2026)

shots.l2A: 这幕场景并不新鲜：两百年前自备织机的【家庭织工】，
shots.l2B: 和今天自费买算力的你一样，都是风险自担的【计件工】。
shots.enA: History rhymes: 18th-century cottage weavers who bought their own looms
shots.enB: mirror today's solo creators paying for GPU subscriptions to do piecework at their own risk.
shots.visual: Historical Archival Twin Ledger (1780 British Putting-Out Weaver vs 2026 Platform Digital Pieceworker: Own Tools, Own Risk)
shots.carryOut: Twin ledger curls into the Triple Concentric Deadlock Rings

shots.l2A: 买量重税、全天待命与同质内卷，【三道铁环】死死扣拢——
shots.l2B: 盲目脱下公司防弹衣，只会让你撞上【十倍的市场摩擦】。
shots.enA: 70% traffic tax, 24/7 burnout, and 60-point commodity wars lock together;
shots.enB: stripping off the firm's armor blindly leaves you facing tenfold market friction barehanded.
shots.visual: Triple Concentric Brass/Vermilion Deadlock Rings (70% Traffic Tax × 24h Self-Exploitation × 60-pt Commodity War)
shots.carryOut: Concentric rings dim and focus into the Zhihu 4,172-Upvote Question Card

shots.l1B: 看清幻觉 · 真正破局
shots.l2A: 知乎【4172赞】问：“为什么每天干十四小时却更焦虑？”
shots.l2B: 只有戳破“一人全能”的泡沫，才能找到真正的【破局路】。
shots.enA: A 4,172-upvote question asks: 'Why do I work 14 hours a day and feel more anxious than at work?'
shots.enB: Piercing the omnipotence bubble is how we find the real path forward.
shots.visual: Fourth-Wall Zhihu 4,172-Upvote Question Card ('为什么满屏都在鼓吹一人公司，我每天工作 14 小时，却比上班时还要焦虑？')
shots.carryOut: Question card flips 180° into warm Dawn Gold Rule 1 Energy Allocation Panel

shots.l1A: 破局 ①：砍掉 60 分杂活
shots.l2A: 第一招：放弃全能执念，用【一成精力】指挥AI干杂活；
shots.l2B: 把剩下九成心血，死磕在机器替代不了的【95分绝活】。
shots.enA: Rule 1: Drop the jack-of-all-trades obsession; spend 10% of your energy directing AI on chores,
shots.enB: and pour 90% into mastering one 95-point craft no machine can replicate.
shots.visual: Rule 1 Energy Allocation Workbench (10% AI Chores Auto-Collapsed vs 90% Deep Craft Bar surging to 95-pt Moat)
shots.carryOut: 90% craft bar unfolds into the 14-Day Minimum Sample Verification Calendar & Payment Card

shots.l1A: 破局 ②：14 天最小验证
shots.l2A: 第二招：别冲动裸辞，先用【14天】做最小样品去收钱；
shots.l2B: 只有陌生人愿意掏【真金白银】复购，才算跑通商业模型。
shots.enA: Rule 2: Never quit blindly; take 14 days to ship a minimum viable sample and charge for it;
shots.enB: only strangers paying real money repeatedly prove your business model works.
shots.visual: Rule 2 14-Day Minimum Sample Verification Table (Day 01..14) + Verified Stranger Repeat Payment Card (+¥299.00 Paid ✓)
shots.carryOut: Payment card glides back onto the opening Solo Founder Desk (Opening-to-Ending Echo)

shots.l1A: 破局 ③：以真名立信用
shots.l2A: 第三招：用你的【真名与专业信誉】兜底，积累长期信任。
shots.l2B: AI只能放大你的规模，唯有【真名信誉】才是最深的护城河。
shots.enA: Rule 3: Stake your real name and professional reputation on every delivery.
shots.enB: AI can only amplify your scale; your real name is the ultimate moat.
shots.visual: Return to Opening Desk (Anxiety tabs close -> Long-Term Trust Charter -> Brass Seal stamps Vermilion '真名兜底' mark)
shots.carryOut: Final frame holds for 4.50s as music resolves to warm F-minor chord
